purpose: Document discrepancies found in DEC-061 PT continental filter and Açores geocod handling

findings.description: Continental municipality count: DEC-061 reported 297, correct value is 278
findings.root_cause: DEC-061 used filter 'prefix 1 or 2' for continental Portugal, which incorrectly included Açores (prefix 2, 19 municipalities). Madeira (prefix 3, 11 municipalities) was correctly excluded.
findings.discrepancy_explanation: 297 - 278 = 19 = exactly the number of Açores municipalities

findings.description: INE geocod structure confirmed: 7-character codes, first digit encodes territory
NUTS2013 to NUTS2024 geocod transition at year 2023

details.fix: _harmonise_geocods() uses municipality name (geodsg) as join key to adopt NUTS2024 canonical geocods throughout all years
details.effect_without_fix: 454 unique geocods across all years instead of 278 (278 + 176 = 454)

corrections_applied_in_dec062: _harmonise_geocods() added to canonicalise NUTS2013→NUTS2024 geocod transitions
Final PT municipal panel has 278 continental municipalities × 16 years = 4448 rows
